verdict.rationale: impots.gouv.fr is the French national tax administration's portal. It is not a hosted SaaS or cloud service where users could choose a storage region, so selecting data residency is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack suggests otherwise; it covers only tax services, payments, forms and site theme settings.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
